description.value: Indian Courtyard Restaurant has been serving authentic North Indian cuisine in New Westminster for over 23 years, specializing in tandoori dishes, aromatic biryanis, and curries made from traditional recipes. The restaurant is particularly noted for its rare Galouti Kababs—finely spiced melt-in-your-mouth kebabs that it claims are unavailable elsewhere in the area. Dine-in, takeout, catering, and third-party delivery are all offered.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The website is fully accessible and provides rich primary evidence. The restaurant's address is consistently stated as 609 12th St, New Westminster, BC—contradicting the OSM community field of 'Vancouver'. Two phone numbers appear on the site: 604-516-8689 in the body/contact section and 604-614-4533 in the footer (matching OSM), indicating an internal inconsistency. No bike-specific amenities are mentioned anywhere on the site, though takeout and vegetarian menu items are clearly evidenced.
concerns: OSM community field says 'Vancouver' but the restaurant is in New Westminster, BC—a separate municipality; website consistently confirms New Westminster.
Phone number inconsistency on the website itself: main body 'Our Contact' section and /contact-us/ page show +1 604-516-8689, while the site footer and OSM both show +1 604-614-4533.
Contact page lists email as 'hello@support.com', which appears to be an unfilled template placeholder; footer and main page correctly show 'hello@indiancourtyard.com'.
enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: A long-established full-service restaurant (23+ years) offering dine-in, takeout, and catering in New Westminster; a legitimate food stop for touring cyclists despite no confirmed bike-specific amenities.

Vegetarian / vegan / GF.detail: Menu includes multiple vegetarian dishes: Vegetable Pakoras, Vegetable Manchurian, Dal Makhni, Shahi Paneer, Chaat Papri, Chole Bhature. No explicit vegan or GF labeling found on the site

wow_evidence: serving authentic North Indian cuisine in New Westminster for over 23 years
